name: Pull-Up (Assisted)
instructions: Set up at the assisted pull-up machine or loop a band over the bar.
Hang with arms fully extended, using the assistance.
Pull your chest to the bar, driving the elbows down.
Lower slowly to full extension. Reduce assistance as you get stronger.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Pull-Up (Assisted) is a beginner pulling exercise for the lats, performed with a machine. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
